Jordan: Tiny trade challenge: one song under 4min + one short visual (film, TV ep, music vid) under 20min. No long reads.
Jordan: I'll go first: Song — 'Fiona Apple - Fast As You Can' (3:56). Visual — 'The Black Hole' (2008 short, ~6min).
Maya: Nice! My picks:
Maya: Song — 'Spoon - The Underdog' (3:36). Visual — 'Home Movie' (experimental short, 12min) — hits different on a rainy evening. :umbrella:

Sam: Song — 'Britney Spears - Toxic' (3:20). Visual — 'Hotel Room' S1E1 (single indie episode, ~25min) 3 slightly over but super bingeable.

Kai: Song — 'Scott Walker - The Electrician' (3:45). Visual — music video: 'Soap&Skin - Me and the Devil' (7min, very surreal).
Indira: Queue for Friday's micro-viewing party? I'll bring snacks. :popcorn:

frontdesk-bot: Note: Needle swap kit located in maintenance closet A2. Please log borrow in #help if you take it.
Maya: Quick poll: react :one: if you want Friday afternoon, :two: for morning coffee slot.
Sam: Playlist idea: I can stitch everyone's song into a 10-track "microset" and drop it in shared drive. Want collaborative?
Kai: Yes please, Sam. Also can someone mirror any short vids to the shared folder for easy playback? Vimeo links get blocked on some networks.
Indira: I'll mirror anything not copyrighted to our /team/media/shorts/ (ask for access).
Jordan: Voting results so far: :one: 4 :two: 2 3o'clock afternoon wins. See y'all Friday 3pm. Bring a 2-minute intro if you want to say why you picked it.
Maya: Also pro tip: if you're hunting sub-20min gems, search "short film" + festival name on YouTube and filter by duration. Lots of hidden winners.
Sam: Shared playlist link (placeholder): https://open.spotify.com/playlist/2exampleNewLink

Indira: I can bring a portable speaker.
Jordan: Perfect. Low-fi screening with snacks. :movie_camera:
